title: Apply the decision to the refresh workflow and land one refresh PR on a counting check
goal: Apply the decision to the refresh workflow and land one refresh PR on a counting check
acceptance: A refresh PR shows a passing check and is merged with merge-when-green
privacy: Neutral content only; no secrets, tokens or personal data in Git. Component repositories are read, never written.
escalation: Material scope growth or effort increase goes to the owner before adoption

effort.basis: Workflow changed in PR #6: checkout, push, PR lookup and PR creation use REFRESH_TOKEN; the workflow token is contents: read; the dispatch step is gone; a missing secret fails the first step (checked offline both ways). Remaining: one dispatched run after the merge whose refresh PR shows the CI check by itself.
